b.0720787f.de:
Erik and Halima recorded how many minutes they practised playing the guitar for one week. Here are their times in minutes.
Write two sentences to describe the amount of time Erik and Halima practised for.

tu_kiem.t: so sánh mean: ai thường tập lâu hơn
so sánh range: thời gian tập của ai đều hơn
dùng số liệu (6 và 7 phút, 3 và 7 phút)

b.0720787f.bai_mau: Halima practised for longer on average (mean 7 minutes, Erik 6 minutes). Erik’s practice times were more consistent, because his range is only 3 minutes and Halima’s is 7 minutes.

b.b1e79fc6.de:
These are the times in seconds of two runners in six 100 m races. Runner 1: **12.7, 10.4, 11.4, 10.8, 12.2, 10.9** · Runner 2: **12.5, 11.9, 10.3, 11.6, 10.8, 11.9**
Give reasons for who is the better runner.

tu_kiem.t: so sánh mean của hai người
so sánh range (ai đều sức hơn)
nhớ rằng thời gian ít hơn là chạy nhanh hơn

b.b1e79fc6.bai_mau: Runner 1 is better because their mean time is lower (11.4 s compared with 11.5 s), so they are usually faster. Their ranges are almost the same (2.3 s and 2.2 s), so both runners are about as consistent.

b.1729de6c.de:
Here are the bowling scores of four players after six games.
a: Player A
b: Player B
c: Player C
d: Player D
Players B and D both have the same average bowling score. Which do you think is the better player? Write a sentence to convince your partner that B or D is better. Use information from the table in your sentence.

tu_kiem.t: nêu B và D có cùng mean (125)
so sánh range: B 36, D 69
dùng số liệu trong bảng để giải thích ai giỏi hơn

b.1729de6c.bai_mau: Player B is better because B and D have the same mean (125), but B’s range is only 36 and D’s range is 69, so B scores about the same every game while D is up and down. You could also argue for D: D’s best games (154 and 160) are higher than any of B’s.

b.67db6fc8.de:
Find the range in heights of these two groups of children. Group 1: **127 cm, 130 cm, 152 cm, 138 cm, 135 cm, 138 cm, 141 cm** · Group 2: **137 cm, 131 cm, 129 cm, 143 cm, 136 cm, 143 cm, 132 cm**
a: Group 1
b: Group 2
Describe how the two groups would look different because of their different ranges.

tu_kiem.t: Group 1 có range lớn hơn: chiều cao chênh nhau nhiều
Group 2 có range nhỏ hơn: các bạn cao gần bằng nhau

b.67db6fc8.bai_mau: Group 1 would have some very short and some very tall children, because their heights spread over 25 cm. The children in Group 2 would look more similar in height, because their range is only 14 cm.

b.e5d5327a.de:
Kali, Summer, Benji and Kyle are learning to skip. While they were practising they recorded how many skips they did in a row. Here are their attempts:
Who do you think has been most successful at skipping? Explain your answer using the information in your table.

tu_kiem.t: chọn một bạn và dùng mean / median / mode để so sánh
dùng ít nhất hai số liệu trong bảng làm bằng chứng

b.e5d5327a.bai_mau: Kali has been most successful. Her mean (7) and median (6) are the highest, and she never scored 0.

b.8fcd2f91.de:
Gabriella and Demi have recorded the temperature in the shade at midday on every day of their six week school holiday (°C).
1: Week 1
3: Week 3
4: Week 4
5: Week 5
6: Week 6
Use the information in your table to argue which was the warmest week of the holiday.

tu_kiem.t: chọn Week 6
dùng cả ba average (mode 32, median 30, mean 30) để chứng minh

b.8fcd2f91.bai_mau: Week 6 was the warmest week. Its mode (32 °C), median (30 °C) and mean (30 °C) are all higher than in any other week.

b.321a1b9c.nguon: LB p.44 Think like a mathematician
b.321a1b9c.de:
Daphne the dog had four litters of puppies. The mean average number of puppies in a litter was 5.
What do you notice about the total number of puppies in each solution where the mean is 5? Explain what you find out.

tu_kiem.t: tổng luôn bằng 20
giải thích: tổng = mean × số lứa = 5 × 4

b.321a1b9c.bai_mau: The total is always 20 puppies. The mean is the total shared equally between the 4 litters, so the total must be 5 × 4 = 20.

b.1e21711c.de:
Jenny knows that the mean of her six cards is 15. She spilled paint on two of her cards. The cards she can still read are **15, 18, 13, 12**. What could the missing numbers be?
What could the missing numbers be? Give two possible pairs.

tu_kiem.t: mỗi cặp cộng lại bằng tổng hai thẻ bị che (câu a)
nêu được ít nhất hai cặp khác nhau

b.1e21711c.bai_mau: The missing numbers could be 9 and 23, or 10 and 22, because each pair adds up to 32 and 58 + 32 = 90 = 15 × 6.

b.cb96e2a2.de: In your own words, write a definition for each of the three averages and the range.

tu_kiem.t: mode: giá trị xuất hiện nhiều lần nhất
median: giá trị ở giữa sau khi xếp theo thứ tự
mean: tổng chia cho số giá trị
range: lớn nhất trừ nhỏ nhất

b.cb96e2a2.bai_mau: The mode is the value that appears most often. The median is the middle value when the data is in order. The mean is the total of all the values divided by how many values there are. The range is the highest value minus the lowest value.

b.8720f2c2.de:
Correct the mistakes in the sentences below.
a: The mean is the number that appears most often in the set.
b: The mean is all the numbers added up and divided by how many numbers there are.
c: The mean is the middle number when the numbers are put in order.
a: The range is the biggest number in the data set.
b: The range is the middle value between the highest and the lowest.
c: The range is not an average. It shows how spread out the data is.
a: There can be one mode, more than one mode, or no mode at all.
b: There can be one mode or two modes, but never more than two.
c: A set of data always has at least one mode.
a: If the data set has an even number of values, the median is the bigger of the two middle values.
b: If the data set has an even number of values, the median is halfway between the two middle values.
c: If the data set has an even number of values, there is no median.
Now rewrite each of the four sentences yourself so that it is correct.

tu_kiem.t: mean: cộng rồi CHIA cho số giá trị
range không phải là average
có thể có nhiều mode hoặc không có mode
chỉ có một median: nửa đường giữa hai số ở giữa

b.8720f2c2.bai_mau: The mean is all the numbers added up and divided by how many numbers there are. The range is not an average; it shows how spread out the data is. There can be one mode, more than one mode or no mode. If the data set has an even number of values, the median is halfway between the two middle values.

b.f184ca72.de:
The tables below show the rankings for the teams which have qualified for this year’s tournament. The rankings were decided according to the teams’ success over the last four years, with number 1 being the highest ranking. Group A: Qatar 48, Ecuador 44, Senegal 18, Netherlands 8 · Group B: England 5, IR Iran 22, USA 14, Wales 19 · Group C: Argentina 3, Saudi Arabia 53, Mexico 12, Poland 26 · Group D: France 4, Australia 39, Denmark 10, Tunisia 30 · Group E: Spain 6, Costa Rica 34, Germany 11, Japan 24 · Group F: Belgium 2, Canada 43, Morocco 23, Croatia 15 · Group G: Brazil 1, Serbia 25, Switzerland 16, Cameroon 38 · Group H: Portugal 9, Ghana 60, Uruguay 13, Korea Republic 28
Would you use the mean or median in this case to compare the groups? Give a reason for your choice.

tu_kiem.t: chọn rõ mean hoặc median
nêu một lý do cho lựa chọn (ví dụ thứ hạng rất cao / rất thấp như Ghana 60, Brazil 1, hoặc mean dùng mọi đội)
dùng số liệu của ít nhất một bảng đấu (mean và median) để minh hoạ lý do

b.f184ca72.bai_mau: I would use the median. Some groups have one very low-ranked team, like Ghana (60) in Group H, which pulls the mean up to 27.5, but the median (20.5) stays close to the middle teams. The median is not changed much by very large or very small rankings. Someone could choose the mean because it uses every team’s ranking, but one very low-ranked team changes it a lot.

b.82cf16c1.de:
The tables below show the rankings for the teams which have qualified for this year’s tournament. The rankings were decided according to the teams’ success over the last four years, with number 1 being the highest ranking. Group A: Qatar 48, Ecuador 44, Senegal 18, Netherlands 8 · Group B: England 5, IR Iran 22, USA 14, Wales 19 · Group C: Argentina 3, Saudi Arabia 53, Mexico 12, Poland 26 · Group D: France 4, Australia 39, Denmark 10, Tunisia 30 · Group E: Spain 6, Costa Rica 34, Germany 11, Japan 24 · Group F: Belgium 2, Canada 43, Morocco 23, Croatia 15 · Group G: Brazil 1, Serbia 25, Switzerland 16, Cameroon 38 · Group H: Portugal 9, Ghana 60, Uruguay 13, Korea Republic 28
a: Group A
b: Group B
e: Group E
g: Group G
h: Group H
Explain why this group’s data is so consistent.

tu_kiem.t: dùng range nhỏ nhất (17)
các đội trong bảng có thứ hạng gần nhau, không có đội hạng rất thấp

b.82cf16c1.bai_mau: Group B has the smallest range (22 − 5 = 17). All four teams are ranked between 5 and 22, so they are quite close in strength and there is no very low-ranked team.

b.e617d531.de:
The tables below show the rankings for the teams which have qualified for this year’s tournament. The rankings were decided according to the teams’ success over the last four years, with number 1 being the highest ranking. Group A: Qatar 48, Ecuador 44, Senegal 18, Netherlands 8 · Group B: England 5, IR Iran 22, USA 14, Wales 19 · Group C: Argentina 3, Saudi Arabia 53, Mexico 12, Poland 26 · Group D: France 4, Australia 39, Denmark 10, Tunisia 30 · Group E: Spain 6, Costa Rica 34, Germany 11, Japan 24 · Group F: Belgium 2, Canada 43, Morocco 23, Croatia 15 · Group G: Brazil 1, Serbia 25, Switzerland 16, Cameroon 38 · Group H: Portugal 9, Ghana 60, Uruguay 13, Korea Republic 28
a: Group A
b: Group B
e: Group E
g: Group G
h: Group H
Most questions based on averages ask for the mode. Why has it not been included in these questions?

tu_kiem.t: mỗi đội có một thứ hạng khác nhau, không số nào lặp lại
nên không bảng đấu nào có mode

b.e617d531.bai_mau: Every team has a different ranking, so no number appears more than once in a group. That means there is no mode, so it would not help us compare the groups.

b.f817e0cf.de:
I measured the height of different children in grade 5. Height of children in 5B1: **140 cm, 140 cm, 130 cm, 154 cm, 121 cm** · Height of children in 5B2: **125 cm, 137 cm, 163 cm, 140 cm, 145 cm**
What conclusion can you make from this data?

tu_kiem.t: so sánh mean: 5B2 cao hơn (142 so với 137 cm)
nhận ra median bằng nhau (140 cm)
so sánh range: chiều cao 5B2 chênh nhau nhiều hơn (38 so với 33 cm)

b.f817e0cf.bai_mau: On average the children in 5B2 are a little taller (mean 142 cm compared with 137 cm), although both classes have the same median, 140 cm. The heights in 5B2 are more spread out, because their range is 38 cm and 5B1’s is 33 cm.

b.bb3724cc.de:
Ahmed calculates: 0.7 + 0.41 = 0.48
He has made a mistake. How can you help him avoid making the same mistake again?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: Ahmed không line up the decimal points (cộng 7 tenths với 41 hundredths như cùng hàng).
Nêu cách tránh: viết 0.7 thành 0.70 (trailing zero) rồi cộng theo cột.

b.bb3724cc.bai_mau: Ahmed added 7 and 41 as if they were in the same place. 0.7 is 7 tenths, so line up the decimal points and write it as 0.70. Then 0.70 + 0.41 = 1.11.

b.f6145221.de: Mr. Charlie says, “34.543 decomposed is 30 + 4 + 0.5 + 0.4 + 0.3”. What mistake has he made?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: sai place value ở hundredths và thousandths.
Viết được 4 hundredths = 0.04 và 3 thousandths = 0.003.

b.f6145221.bai_mau: He has not got the place value of the hundredths and thousandths correct: the 4 is worth 0.04 and the 3 is worth 0.003.

b.de85253f.nguon: LMS: Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 4)

tu_kiem.t: Tính được A, B, D, E đều bằng 2.123 (chỉ regroup theo cách khác).
Nêu được C bằng 3.13 nên C khác.

b.de85253f.bai_mau: A, B, D and E are all equal to 2.123. They are the same number regrouped in different ways. C is 2 + 1.1 + 0.03 = 3.13, so C is the odd one out.

b.06762f94.nguon: LMS: Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 9)
b.06762f94.de:
Tiny has represented 16.53 + 5.485 on a place value chart. The table shows how many counters Tiny put in each column.
Table (T | O | Tth | Hth | Thths):
- 16.53: 1, 6, 5, 3, 0
- 5.485: 5, 4, 8, 5, 0
What mistake has Tiny made?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: Tiny đặt 5.485 lệch một cột sang trái (bảng thành 54.85) vì không line up the decimal points.
Nói được 5.485 là 5 ones, 4 tenths, 8 hundredths, 5 thousandths.

b.06762f94.bai_mau: Tiny has put every digit of 5.485 one column too far to the left, so the second row shows 54.85, not 5.485. The decimal points must line up: 5.485 is 5 ones, 4 tenths, 8 hundredths and 5 thousandths.

b.2e944d7b.de:
Alex subtracted 3.28 from 15.4 like this:
15.4 − 3.28 = 12.22 (Alex wrote: 8 − 0 = 8, 4 − 2 = 2, 15 − 3 = 12)
Explain the mistake Alex made and find the correct answer.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: Alex không viết placeholder zero (15.40) nên lấy 8 − 0 thay vì regroup rồi tính 10 − 8.
Có đáp số đúng 12.12.

b.2e944d7b.bai_mau: Alex forgot to write a placeholder zero in the hundredths column (15.40). As a result, Alex subtracted 0 from 8 instead of regrouping and subtracting 8 from 10. The correct answer is 15.40 − 3.28 = 12.12.

b.25be2b1c.nguon: LMS: Handbook to help explanations Q2
b.25be2b1c.de:
Emma bought a book for £6.45 and a pencil for £1.80. She paid with a £20 note.
Emma calculated her change: £20.00 − £6.45 = £13.55. She said her change is £13.55.
Explain the mistake Emma made in solving the word problem.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: Emma quên trừ tiền cái pencil (£1.80).
Nói cách đúng: tính total cost của hai món trước, rồi lấy £20 trừ đi.

b.25be2b1c.bai_mau: Emma forgot to subtract the cost of the pencil (£1.80). She only subtracted the book (£6.45) from £20.00. She must find the total cost of both items first: £6.45 + £1.80 = £8.25. Change = £20.00 − £8.25 = £11.75.

b.de86dc4e.de: A student solved 12.45 − 3.829 and got 9.631. What mistake did they make?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: bạn ấy exchange 1 sang cột bên phải nhưng không bớt 1 ở cột cho mượn (hundredths vẫn tính 5 − 2, ones vẫn tính 12 − 3).
Nêu cách làm đúng: 12.450 − 3.829 (placeholder zero), exchange xong thì bớt 1 ở cột cho mượn — hoặc estimate 12 − 4 = 8 để thấy 9.631 quá lớn.

b.de86dc4e.bai_mau: The student exchanged but did not take the 1 away from the column they exchanged from: in the hundredths they did 5 − 2 = 3 instead of 4 − 2 = 2, and in the ones they did 12 − 3 = 9 instead of 11 − 3 = 8. The correct answer is 12.450 − 3.829 = 8.621.

b.0eea6888.nguon: LB p.120 Think like a mathematician

tu_kiem.t: Nêu được: numerator của đáp số = tổng hai denominator.
Nêu được: denominator của đáp số = tích hai denominator.

Thử quy luật trên MỘT phép cộng cụ thể: nêu rõ phép cộng (vd 1/5 + 1/2) rồi chỉ ra numerator của đáp số = tổng hai denominator VÀ denominator của đáp số = tích hai denominator (chỉ ghi một phép cộng hai số như 5 + 2 = 7 thì chưa đạt).

b.0eea6888.bai_mau: For 1/a + 1/b, the numerator of the answer is a + b and the denominator is a × b. For example {1/7} + {1/4} = {11/28}: 7 + 4 = 11 and 7 × 4 = 28.

b.fae01f66.de:
Chata solved this calculation: {3/5} + {3/8} = {6/13}
What mistake has Chata made?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: Chata cộng cả numerator lẫn denominator.
Nói cách đúng: đổi về common denominator 40 rồi chỉ cộng numerator.

b.fae01f66.bai_mau: Chata added the numerators and added the denominators. You must change both fractions to a common denominator first: {3/5} + {3/8} = {24/40} + {15/40} = {39/40}.

b.0e0dcd98.de:
Mia tried to add two fractions: {1/4} + {2/5}.
Mia wrote: {1/4} + {2/5} = (1 + 2) / (4 + 5) = {3/9} = {1/3}.
Explain the mistake Mia made and calculate the correct answer.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: Mia cộng cả numerator lẫn denominator — câu phải nói CẢ HAI (chỉ nói Mia cộng denominator thì chưa đạt).
Nói cách đúng: đổi về common denominator 20 rồi chỉ cộng numerator.

b.0e0dcd98.bai_mau: Mia added the numerators together and also added the denominators together. You cannot add fractions with different denominators directly. Mia must first change both fractions to equivalent fractions with a common denominator of 20: {1/4} = {5/20} and {2/5} = {8/20}, so {5/20} + {8/20} = {13/20}.

b.31ec67ba.de: Leila says, ‘The number represented in the place value grid is the largest number that can be made with nine counters.’ Do you agree? Explain your reasoning. (Grid: 10s 5 counters · 1s 1 counter · 1/10 1 counter · 1/100 1 counter · 1/1000 1 counter)

tu_kiem.t: đọc lưới: số trong lưới là 51.111 (9 counter)
đưa một số lớn hơn 51.111 làm được bằng chín counter (vd cả chín ở cột tens = 90)
kết luận Leila chưa đúng

b.31ec67ba.bai_mau: I do not agree. The grid shows 51.111. If Leila put all nine counters in the tens column she would make 90, and 90 is bigger than 51.111.

b.453c45a0.de: Mr. Jon says “In the number 367.461 both the 6 digits are worth the same.” Is he correct? Explain why he is / isn’t.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: Mr. Jon không đúng vì hai digit 6 đứng ở hai place value khác nhau
Nêu place value của từng digit được hỏi: tens và hundredths
Nêu value của từng digit được hỏi: 60 và 0.06

b.453c45a0.bai_mau: Mr. Jon is not correct. The first 6 is in the tens place, so it is worth 60. The second 6 is in the hundredths place, so it is worth 0.06. They are in different places, so they are worth different amounts.

b.83c819b4.de: Ms. Colette reads the number 17.539 out loud. She says: “The number is seventeen point five-hundred and nine. The three is worth hundredths.” Is she correct? What mistake(s) has she made?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu lỗi chính: phần sau decimal point phải đọc từng digit, không đọc như một số nguyên
Viết lại cách đọc đúng: seventeen point five three nine
Nhận ra phần «the three is worth hundredths» là đúng

b.83c819b4.bai_mau: She is not correct. After the decimal point each digit is read on its own, so the number is “seventeen point five three nine”, not “point five-hundred and nine”. The three is worth 3 hundredths, so that part is correct.

b.ce883597.de:
Which of the following is the odd one out? Why?
a: 5.628
b: 5,628 thousandths
c: 56 tenths and 28 thousandths
d: 56 hundredths and 28 tenths

tu_kiem.t: Nêu ba dòng cùng giá trị: ba dòng còn lại cùng bằng 5.628, chỉ viết khác nhau
Nêu dòng lẻ khác giá trị: 56 hundredths and 28 tenths bằng 3.36

b.ce883597.bai_mau: 5.628, 5628 thousandths and 56 tenths and 28 thousandths are all the same number, 5.628, written in different ways. 56 hundredths and 28 tenths is 0.56 + 2.8 = 3.36, so it is the odd one out.

b.84f75b96.nguon: LMS Place Value – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 3)
b.84f75b96.de:
Jack has got some place value counters.
“Some of my counters have a value of 1,000,000, some have a value of 10,000 and some have a value of 1”
Jack picks four counters.
What different numbers greater than 1,000,000 could he make?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu ít nhất hai số khác nhau: mỗi số được tạo từ đúng bốn counter loại 1000000, 10000 hoặc 1
Điều kiện lớn hơn: mỗi số nêu ra lớn hơn 1000000 (có ít nhất một counter 1000000)

b.84f75b96.bai_mau: He could make 1,030,000 (one counter of 1,000,000 and three counters of 10,000), or 3,000,001 (three counters of 1,000,000 and one counter of 1), or 2,020,000 (two counters of 1,000,000 and two counters of 10,000). Each number is greater than 1,000,000 because it uses at least one counter of 1,000,000.

b.1e6115a6.de:
Find the odd one out. Explain your answer.
a: 1.234
b: 1234 thousandths
c: 12.34
d: 123.4 hundredths
e: 123 hundredths and 4 thousandths

tu_kiem.t: chọn số khác: 12.34
chứng minh: bốn số còn lại đều bằng 1.234

b.1e6115a6.bai_mau: 12.34 is the odd one out. The other four numbers are all equal to 1.234 but 12.34 is ten times bigger.

b.7ecac2d8.de: Explain why 0.123 is not the same as 0.1 + 0.2 + 0.3. Use the place value of each digit in your explanation.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu cách khai triển đúng: 0.123 là 1 tenth, 2 hundredths và 3 thousandths
Chỉ ra vì sao phép cộng sai: 0.2 và 0.3 đều là tenths nên tổng 0.1 + 0.2 + 0.3 là 0.6

b.7ecac2d8.bai_mau: 0.123 is 1 tenth, 2 hundredths and 3 thousandths, which is 0.1 + 0.02 + 0.003. In 0.1 + 0.2 + 0.3 the 2 and the 3 are both written as tenths, so they are worth 0.2 and 0.3, and the total is 0.6. The digits 2 and 3 are in different places in 0.123.

b.a3f2eb7c.de:
Conject: How many different ways can you regroup this number?
**782.493**
Now write as many different ways as you can.

tu_kiem.t: Viết ít nhất hai cách regroup: mỗi cách là một tổng các phần của 782.493
Kiểm lại phép cộng: mỗi tổng đã viết phải bằng 782.493

b.29070160.de: Ms. Colette says “5,807 divided by 1,000 is 5.87”. Is she correct? What mistake has she made?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu lỗi chính: cô ấy làm mất digit 0 ở hundredths
Nêu kết quả đúng: 5807 ÷ 1000 bằng 5.807

b.29070160.bai_mau: She is not correct. Dividing by 1000 moves every digit three places to the right, so 5,807 ÷ 1,000 = 5.807. Ms. Colette left out the 0 in the hundredths place and wrote 5.87.

b.72abe16a.de: Ingrid says, ‘I can multiply by 100 by adding two zeros.’ Explain why Ingrid is wrong.

tu_kiem.t: cách thêm hai zero: chỉ đúng với số nguyên (whole number)
đưa một ví dụ số decimal × 100 (vd 1.5 × 100 = 150, không phải 1.500)
cách đúng: mỗi digit dịch sang trái hai hàng

b.72abe16a.bai_mau: Adding two zeros only works for whole numbers. When you multiply by 100, every digit moves two places to the left. For example, 1.5 × 100 = 150, but adding two zeros would give 1.500, which is still 1.5.

b.1725352d.de:
Look at these number cards. Write the correct letter of the card next to the correct sentence.
A 6.1   B 61   C 610   D 0.61
Write your own sentence for the card that is left.

tu_kiem.t: Viết một câu đúng cho thẻ C (610): dùng phép × hoặc ÷ 10, 100, 1000 với một số khác
Câu đưa ra phải đúng về value (kiểm lại phép tính)

b.1725352d.bai_mau: 610 is one hundred times bigger than 6.1. (Also: 610 is ten times bigger than 61, or one thousand times bigger than 0.61.)

b.47231ddc.nguon: LMS Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 11)
b.47231ddc.de:
Tiny is multiplying numbers by 100.
“When you multiply by 100, you just add two zeros to the end of the number.”
Give an example of a calculation where Tiny’s method works.

tu_kiem.t: Ví dụ đúng: nhân một số nguyên với 100 mà cách của Tiny cho kết quả đúng
Kết quả: nêu đúng kết quả của ví dụ đã đưa

b.47231ddc.bai_mau: Tiny’s method works for whole numbers: 7 × 100 = 700, and adding two zeros to 7 gives 700.

b.3d4a1684.nguon: LMS Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 11)
b.3d4a1684.de:
Tiny is multiplying numbers by 100.
“When you multiply by 100, you just add two zeros to the end of the number.”
Give an example of a calculation where Tiny’s method does **not** work.

tu_kiem.t: Ví dụ sai: nhân một số decimal với 100 mà thêm hai số 0 cho kết quả sai
Kết quả: nêu đúng kết quả của ví dụ đó

b.3d4a1684.bai_mau: Tiny’s method does not work for decimals: 2.5 × 100 = 250, but adding two zeros to 2.5 gives 2.500, which is still 2.5.

b.5c7e30b4.nguon: LMS Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 11)
b.5c7e30b4.de:
Tiny is multiplying numbers by 100.
“When you multiply by 100, you just add two zeros to the end of the number.”
What is a better way to explain how to multiply by 100?

tu_kiem.t: Giải thích đúng: khi nhân 100, mỗi digit dịch hai place value sang trái
Phạm vi: cách giải thích đúng cho cả số nguyên lẫn decimal

b.5c7e30b4.bai_mau: When you multiply by 100, every digit moves two places to the left, so each digit becomes 100 times bigger. This works for whole numbers and for decimals: 2.5 × 100 = 250 because the 2 moves from ones to hundreds and the 5 moves from tenths to tens.

b.ca052928.nguon: LMS Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 13)
b.ca052928.de:
Tiny says “When you divide by 10, 100 or 1,000, you just remove the zeros.”
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: không đồng ý
Đưa ví dụ phản bác: chia một số không có số 0 ở cuối cho 10, 100 hoặc 1000
Giải thích đúng: mỗi digit dịch sang phải theo place value

b.ca052928.bai_mau: I do not agree. 45 ÷ 10 = 4.5, and there are no zeros to remove. When you divide by 10, every digit moves one place to the right, so each digit becomes 10 times smaller. It only looks like removing a zero when the number ends in 0, for example 450 ÷ 10 = 45.

b.9eac3007.de: Tom says, “To multiply by 10, just put a zero on the end. So 2.5 times 10 is 2.50.” Is Tom correct? Explain.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: Tom không đúng
Nêu lý do: viết thêm digit 0 ở cuối phần decimal không đổi value (2.50 bằng 2.5)
Nêu cách đúng: khi × 10 mỗi digit dịch sang trái một place, nên 2.5 × 10 bằng 25

b.9eac3007.bai_mau: Tom is not correct. 2.50 has the same value as 2.5, so putting a zero on the end does not change the number. When you multiply by 10, every digit moves one place to the left, so 2.5 × 10 = 25.

b.bbcbc666.nguon: LMS Place Value – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 14)
b.bbcbc666.de:
“56,700 is greater than 201,000 because 5 is greater than 2.”
Explain the mistake that Tiny has made.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu lỗi chính: Tiny chỉ so hai digit đầu mà không xét số digit và place value của mỗi số
Nêu cách so sánh đúng: 201000 có 6 digit, 56700 chỉ có 5 digit, nên 201000 lớn hơn

b.bbcbc666.bai_mau: Tiny only compared the first digits. 56,700 has 5 digits and its first digit is in the ten-thousands place, but 201,000 has 6 digits and its first digit is in the hundred-thousands place. So 201,000 is greater than 56,700.

b.1e5a6199.nguon: LMS Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 1)
b.1e5a6199.de:
Tiny says “The more decimal places a number has, the smaller the number is.”
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: không đồng ý — số có nhiều decimal places hơn chưa chắc nhỏ hơn
Đưa ví dụ cụ thể: hai số, một số ít decimal places và một số nhiều decimal places, so sánh theo place value

b.1e5a6199.bai_mau: I do not agree. The number of decimal places does not tell you the size. 0.5 has one decimal place and 0.123 has three, but 0.5 = 0.500, which has 5 tenths, and 0.123 has only 1 tenth, so 0.5 is greater.

b.ac2f8a3a.nguon: LMS Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 6)
b.ac2f8a3a.de:
Is the statement always true, sometimes true or never true?
“A number with 3 decimal places is greater than a number with only 1 decimal place.”
a: Always true
b: Sometimes true
c: Never true
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: đôi khi đúng
Đưa hai ví dụ: một cặp số làm câu đúng và một cặp làm câu sai

b.ac2f8a3a.bai_mau: It is sometimes true. 5.123 has 3 decimal places and is greater than 0.5, which has 1 decimal place. But 0.123 has 3 decimal places and is smaller than 0.5. So the number of decimal places alone does not decide which number is greater.

b.1f3068f0.de: Stefan says, ‘When I round 16.51 and 17.49 to the nearest whole number, the answer is the same. When I round 16.51 and 17.49 to the nearest tenth, the difference between the answers is one.’ Explain why Stefan is correct.

tu_kiem.t: nearest whole number: cả hai số đều round về 17
nearest tenth: hai kết quả là 16.5 và 17.5
kết luận: hiệu 17.5 − 16.5 = 1 nên Stefan đúng

b.1f3068f0.bai_mau: To the nearest whole number, 16.51 rounds to 17 and 17.49 rounds to 17, so the answers are the same. To the nearest tenth, 16.51 rounds to 16.5 and 17.49 rounds to 17.5. The difference between 17.5 and 16.5 is 1, so Stefan is correct.

b.08708ddb.de: Jasper says, ‘7.97 is 8 when rounded to the nearest whole number and is also 8 when rounded to the nearest tenth.’ Is Jasper correct? Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: nearest whole number: 7.97 round về 8
nearest tenth: 7.97 round về 8.0 (phải có 1 decimal place)
kết luận: Jasper chưa đúng

b.08708ddb.bai_mau: Jasper is not correct. 7.97 is 8 to the nearest whole number, but to the nearest tenth it is 8.0, because the answer keeps one decimal place.

b.26f982ba.de:
Mr. Jon thinks of a number.
- It is greater than 45.
- Has an even number in the tenths and hundredths.
- Rounds to 60 when rounding to the nearest 10.
What could his number be?

tu_kiem.t: Điều kiện về độ lớn và digit: số lớn hơn 45, tenths và hundredths đều là digit chẵn
Điều kiện round: tới nearest 10 ra 60, nên số nằm từ 55 tới dưới 65

b.26f982ba.bai_mau: It could be 58.24. It is greater than 45, the tenths digit 2 and the hundredths digit 4 are both even, and 58.24 rounds to 60 to the nearest 10.

b.d1aade4d.de: Write an explanation of how to round decimals to the nearest tenth.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu bước nhìn digit ở hundredths để quyết định round up hay giữ nguyên
Nêu quy tắc đúng: hundredths từ 5 tới 9 thì tenths tăng 1, từ 0 tới 4 thì tenths giữ nguyên
Có ví dụ cụ thể: một số có 2 decimal places

b.d1aade4d.bai_mau: To round to the nearest tenth, look at the hundredths digit. If it is 5, 6, 7, 8 or 9, the tenths digit goes up by 1. If it is 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4, the tenths digit stays the same. For example, 5.67 rounds to 5.7 because the hundredths digit is 7, and 5.44 rounds to 5.4 because the hundredths digit is 4.

b.76293799.nguon: LMS Nearest Whole Number writing Q3
b.76293799.de: Write a question involving rounding a decimal number to a whole number. Show an incorrect answer and explain the mistake.

tu_kiem.t: Viết một câu hỏi round một số decimal tới nearest whole number
Nêu một đáp số sai cho câu hỏi đó
Giải thích đúng lỗi dẫn tới đáp số sai (ví dụ nhìn nhầm digit hoặc round down khi phải lên)

b.76293799.bai_mau: Question: Round 6.58 to the nearest whole number. Incorrect answer: 6. The mistake: the tenths digit is 5, and 5 means round up, but this answer rounded down. The correct answer is 7.

b.67d01561.de: Lan rounds 14.47 to the nearest whole number. She writes, “14.47 rounds to 14.5, and 14.5 rounds to 15, so the answer is 15.” Is Lan correct? Explain.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: Lan không đúng
Nêu lý do: chỉ nhìn digit ở tenths của số ban đầu (4 nhỏ hơn 5), không round hai lần
Nêu đáp số đúng: 14.47 round tới nearest whole number là 14

b.67d01561.bai_mau: Lan is not correct. To round to the nearest whole number you only look at the tenths digit of 14.47. It is 4, which is less than 5, so 14.47 rounds down to 14. Rounding twice made the number go up to 15 by mistake.
